title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #18

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Fatiha have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 7

2. What should a Muslim say before starting to read the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Only Alhamdulillah
   B. Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   C. Only Allahu Akbar
   D. Nothing at all

3. Which surah teaches us to thank Allah and stay humble when we succeed? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Kafirun

4. What does the Qur'an (7:31) say about eating and drinking? (1 mark)
   A. Never eat sweets
   B. Eat only at night
   C. Eat as much as possible
   D. Eat and drink but do not waste

5. What is a good way to remember to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Only brush when a friend does
   B. Forget it
   C. Leave it to the weekend
   D. Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall

6. What is a siwak? (1 mark)
   A. A type of cloth
   B. A water pot
   C. A small stick used to clean the teeth
   D. A prayer mat

7. Which activity is not allowed in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Playing football fairly
   B. Running
   C. Betting on a game
   D. Swimming

8. Why should a Muslim not cheat in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating is a Sunnah
   B. Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   C. Referees are strict
   D. Cheating is fun

9. Which of these is an Islamic etiquette in sport? (1 mark)
   A. Bad words
   B. Skipping prayer
   C. No insults or fighting
   D. Betting

10. What is our response to Allah's mercy? (1 mark)
   A. Be harsh
   B. Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   C. Ignore others
   D. Be proud

11. What does "Ar-Rahman" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The King
   B. The All-Seeing
   C. The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   D. The All-Hearing

12. Which prophet is linked with honesty and truthfulness in hard times, including prison? (1 mark)
   A. Hud
   B. Yusuf
   C. Lut
   D. Ayyub

13. What is wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Giving zakat
   B. Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   C. A journey
   D. Reciting the Qur'an

14. Which spots are often missed in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. The nose only
   B. The top of the head only
   C. The teeth
   D. Heels, elbows and behind the ears

15. What is sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting
   B. Standing
   C. Prostration
   D. Bowing

16. Which is a condition and not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Covering the awrah
   B. Fatiha
   C. Taslim
   D. Sujud

17. When is the last tashahhud recited? (1 mark)
   A. In the first rak'ah
   B. In ruku
   C. In the final sitting
   D. In sujud

18. Which animal is often used to pull ploughs on farms? (1 mark)
   A. Lion
   B. Giraffe
   C. Ox
   D. Zebra

19. Which statement about dress is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody has rules
   B. Boys also have rules of modesty
   C. Only girls have rules
   D. Rules are only for adults

20. A girl wants to play football modestly. Which outfit suits? (1 mark)
   A. A see-through top
   B. A very tight top
   C. A torn shirt
   D. Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf

21. Which is an example of wasteful dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Repairing a shirt
   B. Washing your clothes
   C. Buying many clothes you do not need
   D. Sharing old clothes

22. What is integrity in media use? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Doing right even when nobody is watching
   C. Copying work
   D. Hiding

23. Which is a life skill related to this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Gambling
   B. Laziness
   C. Avoiding begging without justification
   D. Wasting money

24. What does "tawakkaltu 'alallah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am tired
   B. I am happy
   C. I depend on Allah
   D. I am hungry

25. Whom did the Prophet kiss when a man said he had never kissed his ten children? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Ali as an adult
   C. His grandson Al-Hasan
   D. A stranger

26. Which verse tells us to fear Allah and respect family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 4:1
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 110:3
   D. Qur'an 1:2

27. About how old was the Prophet at the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. About ten
   B. About sixty
   C. About twenty
   D. About forty

28. Who did Khadija take the Prophet to for advice? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   C. Abu Talib
   D. Abu Lahab

29. In which cave did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Uhud
   B. Safa
   C. Hira
   D. Thawr

30. Which quality did the early converts show? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Loyalty and courage
   C. Greed
   D. Cowardice

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu. (3 marks)

32. Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children. (3 marks)

33. Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam. (4 marks)

34. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

35. State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (4 marks)

36. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

37. Give one example of each type of najasa. (3 marks)

38. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

39. Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners. (5 marks)

40. What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains? (3 marks)

41. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)

42. Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing. (3 marks)

43. How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help? (4 marks)

44. State two reasons why a Muslim recites Al-Fatiha in every prayer. (2 marks)

45. Name the first and the last prophet. (2 marks)

46. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 7
   Al-Fatiha has seven verses.

2. B — Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   This is the recommended way to begin recitation.

3. A — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr speaks of victory and tells us to praise Allah and ask forgiveness.

4. D — Eat and drink but do not waste
   Allah does not love those who waste.

5. D — Make a chart or routine on the bathroom wall
   Routine builds habits.

6. C — A small stick used to clean the teeth
   The siwak comes from the arak tree.

7. C — Betting on a game
   Gambling is forbidden.

8. B — Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   Honesty applies in games too.

9. C — No insults or fighting
   A Muslim keeps good manners on the field.

10. B — Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   Mercy received should be shown.

11. C — The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   Ar-Rahman shows Allah's mercy to all creation.

12. B — Yusuf
   The Qur'an calls Yusuf "Siddiq".

13. B — Washing certain body parts with water before prayer
   Wudhu is ablution.

14. D — Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   Wash all parts carefully.

15. C — Prostration
   Forehead on the ground.

16. A — Covering the awrah
   It is met before the prayer starts.

17. C — In the final sitting
   In the last sitting.

18. C — Ox
   Oxen pull ploughs and carts.

19. B — Boys also have rules of modesty
   Both boys and girls dress modestly.

20. D — Tracksuit with long trousers and sports headscarf
   It allows free movement and modesty.

21. C — Buying many clothes you do not need
   Waste is disliked.

22. B — Doing right even when nobody is watching
   Allah sees everything.

23. C — Avoiding begging without justification
   Self-awareness.

24. C — I depend on Allah
   Tawakkul is trust in Allah.

25. C — His grandson Al-Hasan
   The Prophet said whoever shows no mercy will not be shown mercy.

26. A — Qur'an 4:1
   Surah An-Nisa 4:1.

27. D — About forty
   He was about forty.

28. B — Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   Waraqa knew earlier scriptures.

29. C — Hira
   The cave of Hira.

30. B — Loyalty and courage
   They stayed firm.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four roles.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Light: urine of a baby boy on milk only; medium: urine, stool, blood or vomit; heavy: dog or pig saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a pillar of the prayer, and it praises Allah and asks Him for guidance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
